title: Supplementary Materials: Database Search Strategies for a Scoping Review of Space Radiation and Human Cancer Risk
description: Full search strategies (Ovid MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, Scopus, Web of Science; searched from inception through September 21, 2026) supporting the PRISMA-ScR scoping review "Human Cancer Risk from Space Radiation Beyond Low Earth Orbit: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Countermeasures for Deep Space Exploration", submitted to the Journal of Applied Physiology.
